body:
Three-issue repair is in progress. The BPB regression failed six cases before the fix and all 15 native evaluator tests pass after it. The recovery and domain tests pass 10 cases, including completion idempotency, live jobs, active leases, stale W&B, changed checkpoint metadata and conflicting final metrics. Repository lint and focused Pyrefly pass. A three-checkpoint comparison against the pinned historical evaluator is prepared; no audit job submitted yet. The original 5e-5 tolerance remains unchanged.

Wikipedia matched p50 W&B was stale at evaluation step 2024, while the saved final step2531 checkpoint and training logs contain the later scores. Restored 30 saved metrics at W&B step2531 after backing up its prior summary and history. All 30 read back exactly and the run remains finished. Training outputs are unchanged.

The native completion records have been reconstructed from the original frozen 28-run plan, before changing the launcher. Both existing p100 records match every reconstructed field. The launcher now waits for all independent branches to settle before propagating exceptions; the live old bundle is unchanged. A recovery coordinator will finalize only successful child jobs without an active artifact lease, then audit restored checkpoints and write corrected metrics separately. CC read-only review is running. Artifacts: .agents/projects/starcoder_tpp10/domain_sweeps/repairs_20260911/.
title: BPB correction and guarded output recovery prepared; p50 W&B repaired
